v.s: Yve detonates (Galactic Energy) at the target location, dealing 200( +80% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies in the area and 145( +60% Total Magic Power) extra (Magic Damage) to those in the center.\nSuccessfully hitting an enemy grants Yve 55% extra Movement Speed (halved if a non-hero enemy is hit) that decays over 1s.\nIf an enemy hero is hit in the center of the area, the cooldown of this skill is reduced by 0.5s.

This is Yve's main damage dealing skill, which requires a relatively high hit rate to deal more extra damage to targets within the central area. Try to cast the skill with the target at the center of the skill range.

Yve summons a (Void Crystal) at the target location, dealing 220( +40% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to nearby enemies.\n(Use Again): Yve commands the Crystal to fire materialized energy in the target direction for 2.7s, dealing 105( +20% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) every 0.45s to enemies hit and slowing them by 25%. Enemies hit multiple times are slowed by an extra 5% for each hit after the first (up to 50%).
This skill enables Yve to block paths when chasing enemies or being chased. Besides, it can slow targets down so that Yve can aim Void Blast more accurately to improve damage output.

Yve creates a Starfield that lasts 15s and gains a 400( +120% Total Magic Power) Shield. Within the duration, you can Tap or Swipe the screen to attack up to 15 times.
(Tap): Deals 340( +120% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies in the target area.
(Swipe): Deals 65( +10% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) every 0.45s to enemies in the target area for 2.7s and slows them by 50%.
Enemies leaving or entering the Starfield will be immobilized for 0.8s (only once against the same target).
Yve cannot be displaced while the Starfield is active, and the Starfield will remain even if Yve is controlled (except for Suppression).
This is Yve's core skill, which greatly enhances her teamfight ability. She can take control of the pace of a battle from a safe distance and deal high damage.

Yve gains a stack of (Galactic Power) each time she hits an enemy hero with (Void Blast) or (Void Crystal) (up to 10 stacks).\nEach stack of (Galactic Power) allows Yve to launch an extra attack on the next (Real World Manipulation) cast and increases the amount of shield gained by 5%.
With Passive, Yve can poke enemies during the laning phase to gain stacks, so as to gain more casts of her Ultimate.
Unique Passive - Ice Bound: When a skill deals damage to an enemy hero, it will also slow them by 10% for 2s (stacks up to 3 times). This effect has a 1s cooldown.
Unique Passive - Mysticism: Getting a kill or assist on an enemy Minion will restore 4% Mana. (An assist occurs when a Minion dies within 2s after taking damage from the hero.)
Unique Passive - Scorch: Burn targets for 3s, dealing Magic Damage equal to 1.5% of the target's Max HP per second.
Unique Passive - Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 3-7 (scales with level) for 2s. Stacks up to 3 times.
Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).
Unique Passive - Guard: Gains a shield equal to 200% of Magic Power. The shield will regenerate 20s after being damaged, and grants 30 Movement Speed while it lasts.
